# Portfolio layout provenance

The generic portfolio renderer was developed with reference to a user-provided repository at https://github.com/Wenbing-X/jjoe (reference commit aa712f306f9814e920f1849653f9ec100c2f5415).

The original repository did not provide a general root license during the reference review. No general open-source license is inferred for its content or media. Personal copy, photographs, template data, and gallery screenshots from that reference are not included in this distribution. Generic layouts are implemented using the builder's own block model and renderer.

Third-party component licenses remain separate and are retained in this repository and its dependency packages.
